SandboxAQ is a high-growth company delivering AI solutions that address some of the world's greatest challenges. The company’s Large Quantitative Models (LQMs) power advances in life sciences, financial services, navigation, cybersecurity, and other sectors.

THE OPPORTUNITY

SandboxAQ’s AI Simulation (AISim) division develops and applies Large Quantitative Models (LQMs) that are grounded in physics, chemistry, mathematics and biology to simulate molecular behavior with scientific precision and accelerate discovery in the physical world across biopharma, chemicals, advanced materials, healthcare, and so much more.

Within AISim, ChemSim is SandboxAQ's AI-driven materials discovery platform. We are seeking an exceptional Product Manager to own the Catalysis vertical. This is a dual-mandate role. Across nearly all of these markets the bottleneck is the same: catalyst discovery and optimization remain slow, experimental and expensive, and the simulation tools available today answer narrower questions than the ones that actually decide a process. This is a once-in-a-career opportunity to shape a category-defining AI platform for materials science at the intersection of national security, scientific discovery, and commercial scale.

Our customers use Semarchy to bring order to data spread across dozens of systems and turn it into something they can trust for reporting, operations, and AI.

You'll build the site, run it, and make it the place enterprise data teams go to discover, see, and try our product, as buyer behavior shifts toward doing more of the research on their own. It's a role for a web developer or engineer who wants to own the whole site, not a slice of it.

We're a small growth team that likes to build. You'll be the team's only engineer, reporting to the Sr. Director, Growth, and working every day with growth, product marketing, and content. As AI changes how marketing gets done, we're investing in how we work: prototyping first, and creating a builder suite that lets the whole team build, not just engineers. You'll have a direct line to the outcome.

What sets this role apart:

•
The site is yours. You're the engineer who owns it, with the tools and support to do it well. You decide how it's built and run, with the freedom to move quickly from an idea to a live page. Owning it runs both ways: when something breaks, it's yours to fix.

•
You'll shape how the site looks, not just how it works. Working from our brand system, you'll take ideas from a prototype, a draft, or a two-line brief to a finished page, with a real say in the design.

•
Every visit counts. Our buyers are a focused, technical audience, so who visits matters as much as how many. You'll make sure every change can be measured, and work with marketing and sales to decide what worked.

•
Today the site runs on WordPress, with PostHog for product analytics. You'll have a real say in how the stack evolves as the site grows.

What you'll do

•
Help marketers ship on their own. Build the foundation of components and templates they launch pages from, so the result looks right without a design review. Step in to add new components when they hit a limit, and build new ideas end to end when they need something the system can't do yet.

•
Improve the journeys that matter most. Work from the homepage and platform pages through to the free trial, demos, and proof-of-value requests. Bring an experimentation mindset: treat each change as a test, judge it by its results, and ship behind feature flags.

•
Build new ways to understand, see, and try the product. Buyers now research with AI and want to try software on their own before they talk to sales. Give them walkthroughs, demos, assessments, and an assistant: start small, scale what they use, and build each one as a pattern we can reuse. You'll shape where this goes with marketing.

•

Ready to revolutionize healthcare, making it faster and more accessible than ever before? 

How we started:

Founded in 2013 by Dwayne D’Souza, HeliosX   was built on a simple but powerful idea: healthcare should be easier to access, faster to receive, and centred around the individual. From day one, we’ve grown without external funding; scaling profitably through technology, disciplined execution, and deep medical expertise. What started as a challenger idea has become one of the most significant healthcare platforms operating globally today.

Where we are now:

We’ve earned the trust of millions of people worldwide through category-leading products and well-known brands, including MedExpress, Dermatica, ZipHealth, RocketRX, and Levity. A key driver of our success is vertical integration; we operate our own manufacturing and proprietary products, led by in-house medical teams, researchers, and pharmacists at the top of their fields.

In 2025, HeliosX treated more than 1.7 million patients globally and reached £781m in revenue, representing +337% year-on-year growth and cementing our position as the clear market leader in the UK. That growth translates into real-world outcomes: our weight-loss treatments helped patients lose 8.5 million kilograms of excess weight in 2025 alone, contributing to an estimated 1,300 fewer cardiac events. This is growth with measurable, life-changing impact at scale.

Today, we operate across four international markets, with successful launches in Germany and Canada and continued expansion in the US. We were also recently recognised in the Sunday Times Top 100 fastest-growing tech companies, further validation of both our momentum and our ambition.

Where we’re going:

2026 is another significant year for HeliosX. Our ambition is to surpass £1.1bn in revenue, continue expanding thoughtfully into new international markets and broaden our condition and treatment portfolio. As we scale, we're focused on building the technology, operational excellence and clinical capabilities that will support sustainable long-term growth. Joining HeliosX now means helping shape the systems, teams and products that will define the next chapter of digital healthcare. You'll be solving complex problems at pace, working alongside exceptional people and building products that genuinely improve lives at scale.

There’s never been a more exciting time to join HeliosX. Come be a part of making our dream of easier and faster healthcare a reality!

The Role:

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to set the technical direction for data at a fast-scaling, international healthtech business. This role focuses on turning data into something that directly shapes what happens for our customers and operations, with a particular emphasis on real-time data and data applications: capturing data from our product systems as it changes, and building the services and applications that allow our web products and operations teams to act on it.

Reporting to the Data Engineering Lead, you will own a business domain and part of the data platform, and work closely with Product, Engineering, Operations and Finance stakeholders. You will also mentor and develop engineers across the team.

What You'll Do:

• Identify data capabilities the business needs, and take them from idea to a trusted service, owning usage, reliability and impact after launch.

• Build real-time and event-driven data pipelines from our product databases, using change-data-capture and streaming technologies.

• Design and deliver services, APIs and applications that put data in front of customers and operations teams.

• Set architecture and technical direction across dimensional modelling, the semantic layer, ingestion strategy, and Snowflake cost and performance.

• Own a business domain and part of the platform, leading incident response and turning lessons learned into guardrails.

• Proactively identify and resolve the issues that hold the platform back
